import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize text labels (case/space variants)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # ensure numeric columns are numeric
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    # fix out-of-range body mass (value entered in mg instead of g: 3650000 -> 3650)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df[df['sex'].notna()]
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
